APPOINTMENTS

A clear beginning.
One step at a time.

Tell our appointments team which visit you are interested in. We’ll help you confirm availability, coverage, and the next steps for intake.

YOUR FIRST STEP

Request an appointment

Select your visit and payment preference to prepare a general enquiry. Please keep personal medical information out of your message.

Our team will explain fees and coverage before your appointment.

Your next step

Open the prepared message in your email application, then send it to our appointments team. Please do not add medical records or insurance-card images.

Email appointment enquiry

The team will confirm availability and appointment details. Preparing or emailing an enquiry does not reserve a time.

Prefer to contact the team directly?
appointments@mindwellflorida.com

A PATH TO CARE

Prepare.
Verify.
Connect.

  1. Confirm your visit.Discuss appointment type, availability, and visit format with our team.
  2. Verify payment details.Confirm current fees or your specific insurance plan and benefits.
  3. Complete secure intake.Use the approved route provided by the team for insurance-card images and patient information.
  4. Confirm your appointment.Receive the date, time, and visit instructions from the practice.
Coverage & payment information
Coverage is not guaranteed until verified.

Confirm network participation, benefits, and any authorization requirements before your visit. For emergencies, call 911; appointment enquiries are not monitored for urgent care.
